column7: Promise: 'Know every deal. Coach every rep. Forget nothing.'; one memory in three layers. Layer 1 ('What was said') is backed by Built call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library); its email and Slack sources are In build / Planned. In build: 'Memory layers two and three: what calls meant, and what happened next'. Flagged by the Narrative: 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)'.
column8: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: all five frame accumulated knowledge as a product asset (ZoomInfo: GTM Context Graph; Jiminny: unified system / CRM as source of truth; Fireflies: 'perfect memory'; Observe.AI: shared data and context across agents; Noota: remembers every conversation). Difference: Observe.AI is the first company in batches 2 and 5 whose inspected pages use the phrase 'Shared memory' (a nav sub-label for its Intelligence and Data layer), but for contact-centre agents, not sales deals; Fireflies and Noota sell personal or team meeting recall; ZoomInfo's graph is account- and data-centric. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): 'memory' is now claimed in words by meeting assistants and a CX platform, so PitchSense's distinctive angle would have to be one memory linking calls, deals, content and coaching for revenue teams; test whether buyers see that link as different from Fireflies' recall or Observe.AI's shared context. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 19, 2026): Only layer 1 of PitchSense's memory is Built (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries, Content Library); memory layers two and three and deal links are In build, and 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)' is flagged by the Narrative, so the linked call-deal-content-coaching memory cannot be shown in public copy yet.

Opportunity (testable hypothesis): channel lists are table stakes in this batch too; test whether naming what the joined channels produce for a deal (not the list) is more credible. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 19, 2026): PitchSense can claim call transcripts (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Fireflies, Fathom, Granola), Slack delivery of summaries and briefs, and documents today; reading email is In build, and CRM connection and Slack deal reading are Planned ('The CRM use cases' and 'Everything about email and Slack tracking' are flagged), so a calls-plus-email-plus-CRM channel claim is not public copy yet.
